research_question: Does any pair of distinct mutually exclusive outcomes inside the three retained fixed-NegRisk September 30 events have a side-specific NO acquisition cost strictly below its one-pUSD payout floor and remain positive after one adverse tick per leg plus exact configured taker fees?
only_changed_adjudication_term: When feesEnabled is false, feeSchedule is absent, and feeType is empty, treat the retained market as explicitly zero configured taker fee. Every feesEnabled=true market must still retain a supported exact positive taker-only fee schedule. The question, retained bytes, three events, 55 markets, 646 pairs, ordering, price gate, tick stress, authority, and output boundary are unchanged from v1.

payoff_identity: Within one fixed-NegRisk event, any two distinct outcomes are mutually exclusive. NO(A) plus NO(B) therefore pays one pUSD when A or B occurs and two pUSD when another outcome occurs, for a one-pUSD floor independent of market direction.
price_gate: Use conservative one minus direct YES bestBid for NO acquisition. Gamma is rejection-only and may not accept or promote an edge. Missing side-specific acquisition evidence is not a free leg.
stress_gate: A pair may advance only when the common minimum executable quantity remains strictly positive after one adverse configured tick on each leg and the exact per-market configured taker fee model, including the frozen zero-fee representation rule.
selection_rule: Enumerate every unordered pair within all three frozen events, rank priced rows by ascending unstressed acquisition cost then event ID and market IDs, and never select a sibling after a later exact-depth failure without a literal new trigger.
prohibited_shortcuts: do not rerun rewrite or reinterpret the consumed v1 contract or failure
do not refetch reprice paginate alias or request a book before the retained screen passes every frozen gate

do not omit an expensive pair or select a pair after viewing economics
